findings.pdf_says: LC_ALL    Locale-categories LC_COLLATE, LC_CTYPE, LC_MESSAGES, LC_MONETARY, LC_NUMERIC, and LC_TIME, and any other categories included in the locale.
findings.markdown_says:
| LC_ALL | Locale-categories LC_COLLATE, LC_CTYPE, LC_MESSAGES, LC_MONETARY, |

LC_NUMERIC, and LC_TIME, and any other categories included in the locale.
findings.detail: The LC_ALL row's description is split: its second line is detached from the table and appears as a standalone paragraph after it, so the table's LC_ALL entry omits LC_NUMERIC, LC_TIME and 'any other categories included in the locale'.
findings.why_it_matters: A reader of the table sees LC_ALL covering only four categories; the full set it controls (including LC_NUMERIC, LC_TIME and any other categories) is outside the table.

findings.detail: The single three-column table (Category / Field name / Description) is fragmented into a plain-text header line, three separate two-column tables and loose paragraphs; mon_decimal_point, mon_thousands_sep and n_cs_precedes fall outside any table, and the p_cs_precedes description is cut, with 'a nonnegative quantity' detached as its own paragraph. The Category column association is lost.
findings.why_it_matters: The table that defines the locale fields the standard references is broken into fragments, so field-to-category association and some field rows are outside the table, and one description is cut mid-sentence.

findings.detail: The '=' row's continuation 'and assignment operator in COMPUTE' is detached from the table into a standalone paragraph, splitting the special-character-word table in two; the '=' entry in the table no longer records its assignment meaning.
findings.why_it_matters: The '=' table entry reads as only a relational operator; its meaning as the COMPUTE assignment operator sits detached outside the table.
